# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the currently deployed public beta and the
current `main` branch. Older releases and historical database snapshots are not
maintained as independently supported versions.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose security vulnerabilities in a public issue or
discussion.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository:

https://github.com/Captain-Boba/EEA/security/advisories/new

If private vulnerability reporting is temporarily unavailable, use the
contact method published on the project owner's GitHub profile to establish a
confidential channel. Do not include exploit details or sensitive data in a
public message.

A useful report includes:

- the affected URL, endpoint, or component;
- the steps required to reproduce the issue;
- the expected and observed behavior;
- the potential security impact; and
- any suggested mitigation, if available.

Please avoid accessing data that does not belong to you, disrupting the public
service, or performing destructive tests. Reports will be reviewed and
coordinated privately before any public disclosure.
